item.title: Destinus: €50 Million Commerzbank Facility Closed, Lifting Total Capital Raised To Nearly €400M
item.description: Destinus, a European aerospace and defense company headquartered in the Netherlands, has secured a €50 million commercial bank financing facility from Commerzbank, marking the company’s first commercial bank facility and backing its next phase of industrial expansion across Europe. item.title: HCLSoftware To Acquire Jaspersoft From Cloud Software Group
item.description: HCLSoftware, the software business division of HCLTech, announced it has signed an agreement to acquire Jaspersoft, an embedded analytics and “pixel-perfect” reporting platform that operates as a business unit of Cloud Software Group. item.title: T-CURX: $20 Million Series A First Closing Raised To Advance Non-Viral CAR-T Pipeline And In Vivo Platform

item.title: StretchSense: $2.3 Million Raised To Drive Global Expansion Of XR Training Gloves

item.title: bp To Sell 65% Of Castrol To Stonepeak At $10.1 Billion Deal
item.description: bp has agreed to sell a 65% shareholding in Castrol to investment firm Stonepeak in a deal that values the lubricants business at an enterprise value of $10.1 billion. The company said the valuation implies an EV/LTM EBITDA multiple of about 8.6x and follows a strategic review that attracted broad interest.
